neighbours.label: contexts that anticipate restriction to a narrow extent (confined to, limited to the smallest ...)
fire: Smoking is restricted to a small area behind the building.
Access is limited to the smallest group of staff necessary.
The fire was contained to just two rooms of the house.
Their search was narrowed to only three candidates.
The outbreak remained confined to a single village.
Rights of way shall be restricted to the narrowest strip possible.
The study was limited to a tiny subset of patients.
Losses were held to almost nothing this quarter.
quiet: Smoking is common in the small area behind the building.
Access is open to every group of staff in the company.
The fire spread through every room of the house.
Their search included dozens of candidates from abroad.
The outbreak spread across many villages.
Rights of way shall be marked with signs along the path.
The study enrolled thousands of patients across Europe.

notes: no dominant token; probes of 'confined to' and 'nearly/almost' stayed under 0.08 of max; best guess from the top example and the output (suppresses narrow/subset/fewer)
